issues.title: Can't start/end route on cluster
issues.body:
When we're planning a route, we may wish it to finish on the location of a cluster.

But, when we click on a cluster, it expands/collapses.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/3bf19d9d2da2353dd0a7c4c6f7021a41.gif)

If it expands to `spiderify` the contents, clicking on one of the `spider` markers may actually be cllcking on the wrong location.

So, when `PlanningForce` is in `not-interactive` mode, the cluster markers should be disabled. This is _probably_ in `createClusterIcon`.  I don't see an `interactive` flag for the `DivIcon` - it may be part of `bubble up events` or a MarkerCluster option.
